# pkc/parser

> pkc: the parser (port of internal/lang/parser.go) and the dump ast format.

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/parser.pkg)

Pattern matching with backtracking over the grammar from `pkc/lang`, in
two passes like the Go compiler: a lenient first pass collects function
signatures, structs, globals and constants, and the second pass checks
every type. Declarations made by failed attempts are undone through an
undo log, so slot numbers depend only on the final tree.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- AST

struct PVar
  name: str
  ty: str
  param: bool
  global: bool
  index: int
end

struct PFrame
  name: str
  scopes: ptr Vec
  slots: int
  params: int
  ret: str
  top: bool
end

struct PNode
  id: int
  kind: str
  rule: ptr LgRule
  file: str
  line: int
  col: int
  ty: str
  snames: ptr Vec
  svals: ptr Vec
  items: ptr Vec
  ival: int
  sval: str
  ident: str
  vr: ptr PVar
  field: ptr TyField
  frame: ptr PFrame
  loop: ptr PNode
  expanded: ptr Vec
  toks: ptr Vec
  start: int
  stop: int
  ofrank: int
end

struct PProg
  main: ptr PNode
  frame: ptr PFrame
  funcs: ptr Vec
  structs: ptr Vec
  top: ptr Vec
  types: ptr Types
  globals: ptr Vec
end

struct PUnit
  name: str
  toks: ptr Vec
  lib: bool
end

struct PSig
  params: ptr Vec
  ret: str
end

fn ps_new_frame(name: str) -> ptr PFrame
  let f = new PFrame
  f.name = name
  f.scopes = vec_new()
  vec_push(f.scopes, vec_new() as int)
  f.ret = ""
  return f
end

fn ps_frame_size(f: ptr PFrame) -> int
  return (f.slots * 8 + 15) & -16
end

fn ps_pos(n: ptr PNode) -> str
  return u_cat4(n.file, ":", str_from_int(n.line), u_cat(":", str_from_int(n.col)))
end

fn ps_nd(v: ptr Vec, i: int) -> ptr PNode
  return vec_get(v, i) as ptr PNode
end

// ps_slot returns the node in slot name, or null.
fn ps_slot(n: ptr PNode, name: str) -> ptr PNode
  if n.snames == null
    return null
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(n.snames) - 1
    if u_get(n.snames, i) == name
      return ps_nd(n.svals, i)
    end
  end
  return null
end

fn ps_set_slot(n: ptr PNode, name: str, c: ptr PNode)
  if n.snames == null
    n.snames = vec_new()
    n.svals = vec_new()
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(n.snames) - 1
    if u_get(n.snames, i) == name
      vec_set(n.svals, i, c as int)
      return
    end
  end
  u_push(n.snames, name)
  vec_push(n.svals, c as int)
end

fn ps_nslots(n: ptr PNode) -> int
  if n.snames == null
    return 0
  end
  return vec_len(n.snames)
end

fn ps_nitems(n: ptr PNode) -> int
  if n.items == null
    return 0
  end
  return vec_len(n.items)
end

fn ps_add_item(n: ptr PNode, c: ptr PNode)
  if n.items == null
    n.items = vec_new()
  end
  vec_push(n.items, c as int)
end

// ps_children: the slots in pattern order, then the items
fn ps_children(n: ptr PNode) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    vec_push(out, vec_get(n.svals, i))
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    vec_push(out, vec_get(n.items, i))
  end
  return out
end

// ps_slot_type is how a binder sees the node it belongs to.
fn ps_slot_type(node: int, name: str, ok: ptr bool) -> str
  let c = ps_slot(node as ptr PNode, name)
  if c == null
    *ok = false
    return ""
  end
  *ok = true
  return c.ty
end

fn ps_number_walk(n: ptr PNode, id: ptr int)
  *id = *id + 1
  n.id = *id
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    ps_number_walk(ps_nd(n.svals, i), id)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    ps_number_walk(ps_nd(n.items, i), id)
  end
end

// ps_number gives every node its ID, pre-order over the top-level items.
fn ps_number(prog: ptr PProg)
  let id = 0
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.top) - 1
    ps_number_walk(ps_nd(prog.top, i), &id)
  end
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- parser state

struct Parser
  lang: ptr Lang
  toks: ptr Vec
  i: int
  frame: ptr PFrame
  funcs: ptr Map
  undo: ptr Vec
  far: str
  far_has: bool
  far_file: str
  far_line: int
  far_col: int
  far_hard: bool
  depth: int
  lenient: bool
  sigs: ptr Map
  types: ptr Types
  declared: ptr Map
  globals: ptr Map
  consts: ptr Map
  gorder: ptr Vec
  loops: ptr Vec
end

struct PFar
  err: str
  has: bool
  file: str
  line: int
  col: int
  hard: bool
end

struct PSnap
  i: int
  undo: int
  frame: ptr PFrame
  toks: ptr Vec
end

struct PUndo
  kind: int
  a: int
  b: int
  c: int
end

const UNDO_DECLARE = 1
const UNDO_MAPKEY = 2
const UNDO_GORDER = 3
const UNDO_CONST = 4

fn ps_new(L: ptr Lang) -> ptr Parser
  let p = new Parser
  p.lang = L
  p.funcs = map_new()
  p.undo = vec_new()
  p.far = ""
  p.sigs = map_new()
  p.types = new Types
  p.types.prims = L.prims
  p.types.structs = map_new()
  p.declared = map_new()
  p.globals = map_new()
  p.consts = map_new()
  p.gorder = vec_new()
  p.loops = vec_new()
  return p
end

fn ps_tok(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr Tok
  return lx_tok(p.toks, p.i)
end

fn ps_node(p: ptr Parser, kind: str, t: ptr Tok) -> ptr PNode
  let n = new PNode
  n.kind = kind
  n.file = t.file
  n.line = t.line
  n.col = t.col
  n.ty = ""
  n.sval = ""
  n.ident = ""
  n.toks = p.toks
  n.start = p.i
  return n
end

fn ps_node_at(p: ptr Parser, kind: str, at: ptr PNode) -> ptr PNode
  let n = new PNode
  n.kind = kind
  n.file = at.file
  n.line = at.line
  n.col = at.col
  n.ty = ""
  n.sval = ""
  n.ident = ""
  n.toks = p.toks
  n.start = p.i
  return n
end

fn ps_later(line: int, col: int, line2: int, col2: int) -> bool
  return line > line2 || line == line2 && col > col2
end

fn ps_errat(file: str, line: int, col: int, msg: str) -> str
  return u_cat4(file, ":", str_from_int(line), u_cat4(":", str_from_int(col), ": ", msg))
end

// ps_fail records a syntax error at t: the error that got furthest is the
// one reported if no alternative succeeds.
fn ps_fail(p: ptr Parser, t: ptr Tok, msg: str) -> ptr PNode
  let err = ps_errat(t.file, t.line, t.col, msg)
  pk_err = err
  if !p.far_hard && (!p.far_has || t.file == p.far_file && ps_later(t.line, t.col, p.far_line, p.far_col))
    p.far = err
    p.far_has = true
    p.far_file = t.file
    p.far_line = t.line
    p.far_col = t.col
  end
  return null
end

// ps_fail_hard records a definite error: the source matched a pattern but
// breaks one of its rules. It wins over syntax errors.
fn ps_fail_hard(p: ptr Parser, file: str, line: int, col: int, msg: str) -> ptr PNode
  let err = ps_errat(file, line, col, msg)
  pk_err = err
  if !p.far_hard || file == p.far_file && ps_later(line, col, p.far_line, p.far_col)
    p.far = err
    p.far_has = true
    p.far_file = file
    p.far_line = line
    p.far_col = col
    p.far_hard = true
  end
  return null
end

fn ps_save_far(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr PFar
  let f = new PFar
  f.err = p.far
  f.has = p.far_has
  f.file = p.far_file
  f.line = p.far_line
  f.col = p.far_col
  f.hard = p.far_hard
  return f
end

fn ps_restore_far(p: ptr Parser, f: ptr PFar)
  p.far = f.err
  p.far_has = f.has
  p.far_file = f.file
  p.far_line = f.line
  p.far_col = f.col
  p.far_hard = f.hard
end

fn ps_clear_far(p: ptr Parser)
  p.far = ""
  p.far_has = false
  p.far_file = ""
  p.far_line = 0
  p.far_col = 0
  p.far_hard = false
end

// ps_best: the most informative error, the one that got furthest
fn ps_best(p: ptr Parser, err: str) -> str
  if p.far_has
    return p.far
  end
  return err
end

fn ps_save(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr PSnap
  let s = new PSnap
  s.i = p.i
  s.undo = vec_len(p.undo)
  s.frame = p.frame
  s.toks = p.toks
  return s
end

fn ps_unwind(p: ptr Parser, s: ptr PSnap)
  while vec_len(p.undo) > s.undo
    let u = vec_pop(p.undo) as ptr PUndo
    if u.kind == UNDO_DECLARE
      vec_pop(u.a as ptr Vec)
      let f = u.b as ptr PFrame
      if u.c == 1
        f.params = f.params - 1
      else
        f.slots = f.slots - 1
      end
    elif u.kind == UNDO_MAPKEY
      map_set(u.a as ptr Map, u.b as str, 0)
    elif u.kind == UNDO_GORDER
      vec_pop(p.gorder)
    elif u.kind == UNDO_CONST
      map_set(p.consts, u.a as str, u.b)
    end
  end
  p.frame = s.frame
end

fn ps_restore(p: ptr Parser, s: ptr PSnap)
  ps_unwind(p, s)
  p.i = s.i
  p.toks = s.toks
end

fn ps_log(p: ptr Parser, kind: int, a: int, b: int, c: int)
  let u = new PUndo
  u.kind = kind
  u.a = a
  u.b = b
  u.c = c
  vec_push(p.undo, u as int)
end

fn ps_is_lit(t: ptr Tok, lit: str) -> bool
  return (t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT) && t.text == lit
end

fn ps_is_closer(p: ptr Parser, t: ptr Tok) -> bool
  return (t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT) && map_has(p.lang.closers, t.text)
end

fn ps_skip_nl(p: ptr Parser)
  while ps_tok(p).kind == TK_NL
    p.i = p.i + 1
  end
end

fn ps_keyword(p: ptr Parser, s: str) -> bool
  return map_has(p.lang.keywords, s)
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- program

// ps_parse parses in two passes; see the module doc.
fn ps_parse(L: ptr Lang, units: ptr Vec) -> ptr PProg
  let p1 = ps_new(L)
  p1.lenient = true
  let first = ps_program(p1, units)
  if first == null
    return null
  end
  let p2 = ps_new(L)
  p2.types.structs = p1.types.structs
  for i = 0 to vec_len(first.globals) - 1
    let v = vec_get(first.globals, i) as ptr PVar
    let g = new PVar
    g.name = v.name
    g.ty = v.ty
    g.global = true
    // globals are numbered in declaration order, so a backend can give
    // each one a fixed address
    g.index = i
    map_set(p2.globals, v.name, g as int)
  end
  for i = 0 to map_len(p1.consts) - 1
    if map_value(p1.consts, i) != 0
      map_set(p2.consts, map_key(p1.consts, i), map_value(p1.consts, i))
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(first.funcs) - 1
    let f = ps_nd(first.funcs, i)
    let sig = new PSig
    sig.ret = f.frame.ret
    sig.params = vec_new()
    for k = 0 to ps_nslots(f) - 1
      let c = ps_nd(f.svals, k)
      if c.kind == "params"
        for m = 0 to ps_nitems(c) - 1
          u_push(sig.params, ps_nd(c.items, m).ty)
        end
      end
    end
    map_set(p2.sigs, f.frame.name, sig as int)
  end
  let prog = ps_program(p2, units)
  if prog == null
    return null
  end
  if !ps_check_calls(p2, prog)
    return null
  end
  return prog
end

fn ps_program(p: ptr Parser, units: ptr Vec) -> ptr PProg
  let main_ = ps_new_frame("main")
  main_.ret = "int"
  main_.top = true
  p.frame = main_
  let prog = new PProg
  prog.frame = main_
  prog.types = p.types
  prog.funcs = vec_new()
  prog.structs = vec_new()
  prog.top = vec_new()
  let body: ptr PNode = null
  for ui = 0 to vec_len(units) - 1
    let u = vec_get(units, ui) as ptr PUnit
    p.toks = u.toks
    p.i = 0
    if body == null
      body = ps_node(p, "block", ps_tok(p))
    end
    while true
      ps_skip_nl(p)
      let t = ps_tok(p)
      if t.kind == TK_EOF
        break
      end
      if ps_is_closer(p, t)
        pk_err = ps_errat(t.file, t.line, t.col, u_cat3("unexpected ", lx_describe(t), " (nothing to close)"))
        return null
      end
      let n = ps_statement(p, true)
      if n == null
        return null
      end
      ps_clear_far(p)
      if u.lib && n.frame == null && (n.rule == null || n.rule.syn.kind != "struct" && !n.rule.syn.top)
        pk_err = u_cat4(ps_pos(n), ": library code (", u.name, ") may only contain functions, structs and top-level declarations such as global and const")
        return null
      end
      vec_push(prog.top, n as int)
      if n.rule != null && n.rule.syn.kind == "struct"
        vec_push(prog.structs, n as int)
      elif n.frame != null
        vec_push(prog.funcs, n as int)
      else
        ps_add_item(body, n)
      end
    end
  end
  prog.main = body
  prog.globals = p.gorder
  ps_number(prog)
  return prog
end

fn ps_statement(p: ptr Parser, top: bool) -> ptr PNode
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  let cands = vec_new()
  if t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT
    let lit = lg_rules(p.lang.stmt_lit, t.text)
    if lit != null
      for i = 0 to vec_len(lit) - 1
        vec_push(cands, vec_get(lit, i))
      end
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(p.lang.stmt_slot) - 1
    vec_push(cands, vec_get(p.lang.stmt_slot, i))
  end
  if vec_len(cands) == 0
    return ps_fail(p, t, u_cat(lx_describe(t), " does not start any statement the loaded packages define"))
  end
  let first = ""
  let have_first = false
  let far = ps_save_far(p)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(cands) - 1
    let r = lg_rule(cands, i)
    let s = ps_save(p)
    let n = ps_match(p, r, top)
    let err = pk_err
    if n != null
      let e = ps_tok(p)
      if e.kind == TK_NL || e.kind == TK_EOF || ps_is_closer(p, e)
        ps_restore_far(p, far)
        return n
      end
      ps_fail(p, e, u_cat("expected end of line, found ", lx_describe(e)))
      err = pk_err
    end
    ps_restore(p, s)
    if !have_first
      first = err
      have_first = true
    end
  end
  pk_err = ps_best(p, first)
  return null
end

fn ps_match(p: ptr Parser, r: ptr LgRule, top: bool) -> ptr PNode
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  if (r.syn.kind == "function" || r.syn.kind == "struct" || r.syn.top) && !top
    return ps_fail(p, t, u_cat4(lx_describe(t), " (", r.pkg.name, ") may only be used at the top level"))
  end
  if r.syn.inloop && vec_len(p.loops) == 0
    return ps_fail_hard(p, t.file, t.line, t.col, u_cat(lx_describe(t), " can only be used inside a loop"))
  end
  let s = ps_save(p)
  let n = ps_node(p, r.kind, t)
  n.rule = r
  if vec_len(p.loops) > 0
    n.loop = ps_nd(p.loops, vec_len(p.loops) - 1)
  end
  let loops = p.loops
  if r.syn.kind == "function"
    n.frame = ps_new_frame("")
    p.frame = n.frame
    p.loops = vec_new()
  end
  if r.syn.loop
    let more = vec_new()
    for i = 0 to vec_len(p.loops) - 1
      vec_push(more, vec_get(p.loops, i))
    end
    vec_push(more, n as int)
    p.loops = more
  end
  let b = ty_binder(n as int)
  let ok = ps_elems(p, r.pat.elems, n, b)
  p.frame = s.frame
  p.loops = loops
  if !ok
    return null
  end
  n.stop = p.i
  if !ps_finish(p, n, b, t)
    return null
  end
  if r.tmpl != null
    return ps_expand(p, r, n, s)
  end
  return n
end

fn ps_frame_name(f: ptr PFrame) -> str
  if f.top
    return "the program"
  end
  return f.name
end

fn ps_describe_type(t: str) -> str
  if t == ""
    return "nothing"
  end
  return t
end

// ps_finish: the result type, return statements, structs and constants
fn ps_finish(p: ptr Parser, n: ptr PNode, b: ptr TyBinder, t: ptr Tok) -> bool
  let syn = n.rule.syn
  let res = n.rule.pat.result
  if res != ""
    let out = ""
    if !ty_subst(b, res, &out)
      pk_err = u_cat3(n.rule.pkg.origin, ": ", pk_err)
      return false
    end
    n.ty = out
  elif syn.kind == "expr" || syn.kind == "infix" || syn.kind == "prefix" || syn.kind == "postfix"
    n.ty = "int"
  end
  if syn.ret
    let f = p.frame
    let v = ps_slot(n, "value")
    if v != null && f.ret == "" && !f.top
      ps_fail_hard(p, v.file, v.line, v.col, u_cat(f.name, " returns nothing, so return takes no value"))
      return false
    elif v != null && !ty_compatible(f.ret, v.ty)
      ps_fail_hard(p, v.file, v.line, v.col, u_cat4(ps_frame_name(f), " must return ", f.ret, u_cat(", but this is ", ps_describe_type(v.ty))))
      return false
    elif v == null && f.ret != "" && !f.top
      ps_fail_hard(p, t.file, t.line, t.col, u_cat4(f.name, " must return ", f.ret, ", so return needs a value"))
      return false
    end
  end
  if syn.kind == "struct"
    return ps_declare_struct(p, n, t)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    let c = ps_nd(n.svals, i)
    if c.kind == "newconst"
      return ps_declare_const(p, n, c)
    end
  end
  return true
end

fn ps_elems(p: ptr Parser, es: ptr Vec, n: ptr PNode, b: ptr TyBinder) -> bool
  for ei = 0 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, ei)
    let t = ps_tok(p)
    if e.lit != ""
      if !ps_is_lit(t, e.lit)
        ps_fail(p, t, u_cat4("expected '", e.lit, "', found ", lx_describe(t)))
        return false
      end
      p.i = p.i + 1
    elif e.optional != null && e.repeat
      let first_lit = pf_elem(e.optional, 0).lit
      let list = ps_node(p, "groups", t)
      while ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), first_lit)
        let g = ps_node(p, "group", ps_tok(p))
        g.loop = n.loop
        if !ps_elems(p, e.optional, g, ty_binder(g as int))
          return false
        end
        g.stop = p.i
        ps_add_item(list, g)
      end
      list.stop = p.i
      ps_set_slot(n, first_lit, list)
    elif e.optional != null
      if ps_is_lit(t, pf_elem(e.optional, 0).lit)
        if !ps_elems(p, e.optional, n, b)
          return false
        end
      end
    elif e.slot != null
      let start = p.i
      let c = ps_slot_parse(p, e.slot, n)
      if c == null
        return false
      end
      c.toks = p.toks
      c.start = start
      c.stop = p.i
      if !ps_constrain(p, e.slot, c, b, t, u_cat4("{", e.slot.name, "} of ", n.kind))
        return false
      end
      ps_set_slot(n, e.slot.name, c)
      if !ps_type_newvars(p, n, e.slot.name, c)
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end

fn ps_describe_constraint(subst: str) -> str
  if !u_has(subst, "?")
    return subst
  end
  return u_cat("of the form ", u_replace(subst, "?", "…"))
end

// ps_constrain checks a parsed slot against its pattern's constraint.
fn ps_constrain(p: ptr Parser, s: ptr PfSlot, c: ptr PNode, b: ptr TyBinder, t: ptr Tok, what: str) -> bool
  if s.kind == "expr" || s.kind == "place"
    if c.ty == "" && s.arg != "any"
      ps_fail(p, t, u_cat(what, " needs a value, but this has none"))
      return false
    end
  elif s.kind != "var" && s.kind != "type"
    return true
  end
  let bad = false
  let ok = ty_matches(b, s.arg, c.ty, &bad)
  if bad
    pk_err = u_cat4(lx_pos(t), ": bad type constraint ", u_quote(s.arg), u_cat(": ", pk_err))
    return false
  end
  if !ok
    let want = ""
    ty_subst(b, s.arg, &want)
    if want == "?" || u_has(s.arg, "[") || u_has(s.arg, "ptr")
      want = ps_describe_constraint(want)
    end
    ps_fail(p, t, u_cat4(what, " must be ", want, u_cat(", but it is ", ps_describe_type(c.ty))))
    return false
  end
  return true
end

// ps_type_newvars gives a variable declared "of" slot its type; with
// several slots listed, the first one present wins.
fn ps_type_newvars(p: ptr Parser, n: ptr PNode, slot: str, c: ptr PNode) -> bool
  let ty = c.ty
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    let v = ps_nd(n.svals, i)
    if v.kind != "var" || v.vr == null || v.sval == ""
      continue
    end
    let of = u_fields(v.sval)
    let rank = -1
    for k = 0 to vec_len(of) - 1
      if u_get(of, k) == slot
        rank = k
      end
    end
    if rank < 0 || v.ofrank > 0 && v.ofrank - 1 < rank
      continue
    end
    if ty_struct(p.types, ty) != null
      ps_fail_hard(p, c.file, c.line, c.col, u_cat4(v.vr.name, " can't hold a struct value; use ptr ", ty, ""))
      return false
    end
    v.ofrank = rank + 1
    v.vr.ty = ty
    v.ty = ty
  end
  return true
end

fn ps_field_name(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr Tok
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  if t.kind != TK_IDENT
    ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("expected a field name, found ", lx_describe(t)))
    return null
  end
  p.i = p.i + 1
  return t
end

fn ps_ident(p: ptr Parser, what: str) -> ptr Tok
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  if t.kind != TK_IDENT
    ps_fail(p, t, u_cat4("expected ", what, ", found ", lx_describe(t)))
    return null
  end
  if ps_keyword(p, t.text)
    ps_fail(p, t, u_cat4("expected ", what, ", found keyword ", lx_describe(t)))
    return null
  end
  p.i = p.i + 1
  return t
end

fn ps_tok_node(p: ptr Parser, kind: str, t: ptr Tok) -> ptr PNode
  return ps_node(p, kind, t)
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- slots

fn ps_slot_parse(p: ptr Parser, s: ptr PfSlot, parent: ptr PNode) -> ptr PNode
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  let k = s.kind
  if k == "expr"
    return ps_expr(p, 0)
  elif k == "place"
    let e = ps_expr(p, 0)
    if e == null
      return null
    end
    if !ps_is_place(e)
      return ps_fail_hard(p, t.file, t.line, t.col, "this can't be assigned to or have its address taken")
    end
    return e
  elif k == "type"
    let ty = ""
    if !ps_type_expr(p, &ty)
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "type", t)
    n.ty = ty
    if parent.frame != null && s.name == "ret"
      parent.frame.ret = ty
    end
    return n
  elif k == "newtype"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a type name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    if map_has(p.lang.prims, id.text) || map_get(p.declared, id.text) != 0
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat3("type ", id.text, " is already declared"))
    end
    map_set(p.declared, id.text, 1)
    ps_log(p, UNDO_MAPKEY, p.declared as int, id.text as int, 0)
    if ty_struct(p.types, id.text) == null
      let st = new TyStruct
      st.name = id.text
      st.fields = vec_new()
      map_set(p.types.structs, id.text, st as int)
      ps_log(p, UNDO_MAPKEY, p.types.structs as int, id.text as int, 0)
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "newtype", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    return n
  elif k == "fields"
    let n = ps_node(p, "fields", t)
    let seen = map_new()
    while true
      ps_skip_nl(p)
      if ps_tok(p).kind == TK_EOF
        return n
      end
      let stop = false
      for i = 0 to vec_len(s.follow) - 1
        if ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), u_get(s.follow, i))
          stop = true
        end
      end
      if stop
        return n
      end
      let id = ps_field_name(p)
      if id == null
        return null
      end
      if map_has(seen, id.text)
        return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat3("field ", id.text, " is declared twice"))
      end
      map_set(seen, id.text, 1)
      if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ":")
        return ps_fail(p, ps_tok(p), u_cat("expected ':' and a type after field ", id.text))
      end
      p.i = p.i + 1
      let ty = ""
      if !ps_type_expr(p, &ty)
        return null
      end
      let fd = ps_node(p, "fielddecl", id)
      fd.ident = id.text
      fd.ty = ty
      ps_add_item(n, fd)
      let nk = ps_tok(p).kind
      if nk != TK_NL && nk != TK_EOF
        return ps_fail(p, ps_tok(p), u_cat("expected end of line after field ", id.text))
      end
    end
    return n
  elif k == "field"
    let id = ps_field_name(p)
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "field", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    let obj = ps_slot(parent, s.arg)
    if obj == null
      pk_err = u_cat4(lx_pos(t), ": field slot names {", s.arg, "}, which comes later or is missing")
      return null
    end
    if obj.ty == "?" || p.lenient && obj.ty == "ptr ?"
      n.ty = "?"
      return n
    end
    let st = ty_struct(p.types, ty_elem(obj.ty))
    if st == null && p.lenient && str_starts(obj.ty, "ptr ")
      n.ty = "?"
      return n
    end
    if !str_starts(obj.ty, "ptr ") || st == null
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat4(ps_field_owner(obj), " has no fields: it is ", ps_describe_type(obj.ty), ", not a pointer to a struct"))
    end
    let f = ty_field(st, id.text)
    if f == null
      if p.lenient && vec_len(st.fields) == 0
        n.ty = "?"
        return n
      end
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat4("struct ", st.name, " has no field ", id.text))
    end
    n.field = f
    n.ty = f.ty
    return n
  elif k == "block"
    return ps_block(p)
  elif k == "newglobal"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a global variable name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    if !ps_declare_top(p, id)
      return null
    end
    let v = map_get(p.globals, id.text) as ptr PVar
    if v == null
      v = new PVar
      v.name = id.text
      v.ty = "?"
      v.global = true
      map_set(p.globals, id.text, v as int)
      ps_log(p, UNDO_MAPKEY, p.globals as int, id.text as int, 0)
    end
    vec_push(p.gorder, v as int)
    ps_log(p, UNDO_GORDER, 0, 0, 0)
    let n = ps_node(p, "var", t)
    n.vr = v
    n.ty = v.ty
    n.sval = s.arg
    return n
  elif k == "newconst"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a constant name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    if !ps_declare_top(p, id)
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "newconst", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    return n
  elif k == "newvar"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a new variable name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    let v = ps_declare(p, id, false, "?")
    if v == null
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "var", t)
    n.vr = v
    n.ty = v.ty
    n.sval = s.arg
    return n
  elif k == "var"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a variable")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    let v = ps_lookup(p, id.text)
    if v == null
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat("unknown variable ", lx_describe(id)))
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "var", t)
    n.vr = v
    n.ty = v.ty
    return n
  elif k == "ident"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "ident", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    return n
  elif k == "func"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a function name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "func", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    let sig = map_get(p.sigs, id.text) as ptr PSig
    if sig != null
      n.ty = sig.ret
    elif p.lenient
      n.ty = "?"
    else
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat("unknown function ", id.text))
    end
    return n
  elif k == "newfunc"
    let id = ps_ident(p, "a function name")
    if id == null
      return null
    end
    if map_get(p.funcs, id.text) != 0
      return ps_fail(p, id, u_cat3("function ", lx_describe(id), " is already defined"))
    end
    map_set(p.funcs, id.text, parent as int)
    ps_log(p, UNDO_MAPKEY, p.funcs as int, id.text as int, 0)
    if parent.frame != null
      parent.frame.name = id.text
    end
    let n = ps_node(p, "newfunc", t)
    n.ident = id.text
    return n
  elif k == "args"
    let n = ps_node(p, "args", t)
    if ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ")")
      return n
    end
    while true
      let e = ps_expr(p, 0)
      if e == null
        return null
      end
      ps_add_item(n, e)
      if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ",")
        return n
      end
      p.i = p.i + 1
    end
    return n
  elif k == "params"
    let n = ps_node(p, "params", t)
    if ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ")")
      return n
    end
    while true
      let id = ps_ident(p, "a parameter name")
      if id == null
        return null
      end
      if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ":")
        return ps_fail(p, ps_tok(p), u_cat4("parameter ", id.text, " needs a type, e.g. ", u_cat(id.text, ": int")))
      end
      p.i = p.i + 1
      let ty = ""
      if !ps_type_expr(p, &ty)
        return null
      end
      let v = ps_declare(p, id, true, ty)
      if v == null
        return null
      end
      let pn = ps_node(p, "var", id)
      pn.vr = v
      pn.ty = v.ty
      ps_add_item(n, pn)
      if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ",")
        return n
      end
      p.i = p.i + 1
    end
    return n
  end
  pk_err = u_cat("internal: unknown slot kind ", k)
  return null
end

fn ps_declare(p: ptr Parser, id: ptr Tok, param: bool, ty: str) -> ptr PVar
  let f = p.frame
  let sc = vec_get(f.scopes, vec_len(f.scopes) - 1) as ptr Vec
  for i = 0 to vec_len(sc) - 1
    if (vec_get(sc, i) as ptr PVar).name == id.text
      ps_fail(p, id, u_cat(lx_describe(id), " is already declared here"))
      return null
    end
  end
  if ty_struct(p.types, ty) != null
    ps_fail(p, id, u_cat4(id.text, " can't hold a struct value; use ptr ", ty, ""))
    return null
  end
  let v = new PVar
  v.name = id.text
  v.ty = ty
  v.param = param
  let pflag = 0
  if param
    v.index = f.params
    f.params = f.params + 1
    pflag = 1
  else
    v.index = f.slots
    f.slots = f.slots + 1
  end
  vec_push(sc, v as int)
  ps_log(p, UNDO_DECLARE, sc as int, f as int, pflag)
  return v
end

fn ps_lookup(p: ptr Parser, name: str) -> ptr PVar
  let f = p.frame
  let i = vec_len(f.scopes) - 1
  while i >= 0
    let sc = vec_get(f.scopes, i) as ptr Vec
    let j = vec_len(sc) - 1
    while j >= 0
      let v = vec_get(sc, j) as ptr PVar
      if v.name == name
        return v
      end
      j = j - 1
    end
    i = i - 1
  end
  return map_get(p.globals, name) as ptr PVar
end

fn ps_declare_top(p: ptr Parser, id: ptr Tok) -> bool
  let key = u_cat("name ", id.text)
  if map_get(p.declared, key) != 0
    ps_fail(p, id, u_cat(id.text, " is already declared"))
    return false
  end
  map_set(p.declared, key, 1)
  ps_log(p, UNDO_MAPKEY, p.declared as int, key as int, 0)
  return true
end

fn ps_find_bad(n: ptr PNode) -> ptr PNode
  if n.kind == "var" || n.kind == "func"
    return n
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    let b = ps_find_bad(ps_nd(n.svals, i))
    if b != null
      return b
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    let b = ps_find_bad(ps_nd(n.items, i))
    if b != null
      return b
    end
  end
  return null
end

fn ps_declare_const(p: ptr Parser, n: ptr PNode, name: ptr PNode) -> bool
  let v = ps_slot(n, "value")
  if v == null
    pk_err = u_cat(n.rule.pkg.origin, ": a pattern with a newconst slot needs a slot named value")
    return false
  end
  let bad = ps_find_bad(v)
  if bad != null
    ps_fail_hard(p, bad.file, bad.line, bad.col, u_cat3("the value of constant ", name.ident, " must not use variables or calls"))
    return false
  end
  let old = map_get(p.consts, name.ident)
  map_set(p.consts, name.ident, v as int)
  ps_log(p, UNDO_CONST, name.ident as int, old, 0)
  return true
end

fn ps_clone(n: ptr PNode) -> ptr PNode
  let c = new PNode
  c.id = n.id
  c.kind = n.kind
  c.rule = n.rule
  c.file = n.file
  c.line = n.line
  c.col = n.col
  c.ty = n.ty
  c.ival = n.ival
  c.sval = n.sval
  c.ident = n.ident
  c.vr = n.vr
  c.field = n.field
  c.frame = n.frame
  c.loop = n.loop
  c.expanded = n.expanded
  c.toks = n.toks
  c.start = n.start
  c.stop = n.stop
  c.ofrank = n.ofrank
  c.snames = null
  c.svals = null
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    ps_set_slot(c, u_get(n.snames, i), ps_clone(ps_nd(n.svals, i)))
  end
  c.items = null
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    ps_add_item(c, ps_clone(ps_nd(n.items, i)))
  end
  return c
end

fn ps_block(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr PNode
  let f = p.frame
  vec_push(f.scopes, vec_new() as int)
  let n = ps_node(p, "block", ps_tok(p))
  while true
    ps_skip_nl(p)
    let t = ps_tok(p)
    if t.kind == TK_EOF || ps_is_closer(p, t)
      vec_pop(f.scopes)
      return n
    end
    let s = ps_statement(p, false)
    if s == null
      vec_pop(f.scopes)
      return null
    end
    ps_add_item(n, s)
  end
  return n
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- expressions

fn ps_expr(p: ptr Parser, min_prec: int) -> ptr PNode
  let start = p.i
  let left = ps_prefix(p)
  if left == null
    return null
  end
  while true
    let t = ps_tok(p)
    if t.kind != TK_PUNCT && t.kind != TK_IDENT
      return left
    end
    let post = lg_rules(p.lang.postfix, t.text)
    if post != null && vec_len(post) > 0 && lg_rule(post, 0).syn.prec >= min_prec
      let n = ps_postfix(p, post, left, start)
      if n == null
        return null
      end
      left = n
      continue
    end
    let rules = lg_rules(p.lang.infix, t.text)
    if rules == null || vec_len(rules) == 0 || lg_rule(rules, 0).syn.prec < min_prec
      return left
    end
    let syn = lg_rule(rules, 0).syn
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let nxt = syn.prec + 1
    if syn.right
      nxt = syn.prec
    end
    let rt = ps_tok(p)
    let right = ps_expr(p, nxt)
    if right == null
      return null
    end
    let first_err = ""
    let have_first = false
    let n: ptr PNode = null
    for i = 0 to vec_len(rules) - 1
      let r = lg_rule(rules, i)
      let ls = pf_elem(r.pat.elems, 0).slot
      let rs = pf_elem(r.pat.elems, 2).slot
      let cand = ps_node(p, r.kind, t)
      cand.rule = r
      cand.start = start
      cand.stop = p.i
      let b = ty_binder(cand as int)
      let ok = ps_constrain(p, ls, left, b, t, u_cat3("left side of '", t.text, "'"))
      if ok
        ps_set_slot(cand, ls.name, left)
        ok = ps_constrain(p, rs, right, b, rt, u_cat3("right side of '", t.text, "'"))
      end
      if ok
        ps_set_slot(cand, rs.name, right)
        ok = ps_finish(p, cand, b, t)
      end
      if ok
        n = cand
        break
      end
      if !have_first
        first_err = pk_err
        have_first = true
      end
    end
    if n == null
      pk_err = first_err
      return null
    end
    if n.rule.tmpl != null
      left = ps_expand(p, n.rule, n, ps_save(p))
      if left == null
        return null
      end
      continue
    end
    left = n
  end
  return left
end

fn ps_postfix(p: ptr Parser, rules: ptr Vec, left: ptr PNode, start: int) -> ptr PNode
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  let first_err = ""
  let have_first = false
  let far = ps_save_far(p)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(rules) - 1
    let r = lg_rule(rules, i)
    let s = ps_save(p)
    let n = ps_node(p, r.kind, t)
    n.rule = r
    n.start = start
    let b = ty_binder(n as int)
    let ls = pf_elem(r.pat.elems, 0).slot
    let ok = ps_constrain(p, ls, left, b, t, u_cat3("the left side of '", t.text, "'"))
    if ok
      ps_set_slot(n, ls.name, left)
      let rest = vec_new()
      for k = 1 to vec_len(r.pat.elems) - 1
        vec_push(rest, vec_get(r.pat.elems, k))
      end
      ok = ps_elems(p, rest, n, b)
    end
    if ok
      n.stop = p.i
      ok = ps_finish(p, n, b, t)
    end
    if ok
      ps_restore_far(p, far)
      if r.tmpl != null
        return ps_expand(p, r, n, ps_save(p))
      end
      return n
    end
    let err = pk_err
    ps_restore(p, s)
    if !have_first
      first_err = err
      have_first = true
    end
  end
  pk_err = ps_best(p, first_err)
  return null
end

fn ps_is_place(n: ptr PNode) -> bool
  return n.kind == "var" && n.vr != null || n.rule != null && n.rule.syn.place
end

fn ps_field_owner(n: ptr PNode) -> str
  if n.kind == "var" && n.vr != null
    return n.vr.name
  end
  return "this"
end

// ps_type_expr parses a type: a name, ptr T, or [T].
fn ps_type_expr(p: ptr Parser, out: ptr str) -> bool
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  if ps_is_lit(t, "[")
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let elem = ""
    if !ps_type_expr(p, &elem)
      return false
    end
    if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), "]")
      ps_fail(p, ps_tok(p), "expected ']' to close the slice type")
      return false
    end
    p.i = p.i + 1
    *out = u_cat3("[", elem, "]")
    return true
  elif t.kind == TK_IDENT && t.text == "ptr"
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let elem = ""
    if !ps_type_expr(p, &elem)
      return false
    end
    *out = u_cat("ptr ", elem)
    return true
  elif t.kind == TK_IDENT
    p.i = p.i + 1
    if map_has(p.lang.prims, t.text) || ty_struct(p.types, t.text) != null || p.lenient
      *out = t.text
      return true
    end
    ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("unknown type ", t.text))
    return false
  end
  ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("expected a type, found ", lx_describe(t)))
  return false
end

fn ps_prefix(p: ptr Parser) -> ptr PNode
  let t = ps_tok(p)
  let start = p.i
  if t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT
    let rules = lg_rules(p.lang.prefix, t.text)
    if rules != null && vec_len(rules) > 0
      p.i = p.i + 1
      let ot = ps_tok(p)
      let operand = ps_expr(p, lg_rule(rules, 0).syn.prec)
      if operand == null
        return null
      end
      let first_err = ""
      let have_first = false
      for i = 0 to vec_len(rules) - 1
        let r = lg_rule(rules, i)
        let sl = pf_elem(r.pat.elems, 1).slot
        let n = ps_node(p, r.kind, t)
        n.rule = r
        n.start = start
        n.stop = p.i
        let b = ty_binder(n as int)
        let ok = ps_constrain(p, sl, operand, b, ot, u_cat3("operand of '", t.text, "'"))
        if ok && sl.kind == "place" && !ps_is_place(operand)
          ps_fail(p, ot, u_cat3("the operand of '", t.text, "' can't have its address taken"))
          ok = false
        end
        if ok
          ps_set_slot(n, sl.name, operand)
          ok = ps_finish(p, n, b, t)
        end
        if ok
          if r.tmpl != null
            return ps_expand(p, r, n, ps_save(p))
          end
          return n
        end
        if !have_first
          first_err = pk_err
          have_first = true
        end
      end
      pk_err = first_err
      return null
    end
  end
  let cands = vec_new()
  if t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT
    let lit = lg_rules(p.lang.expr_lit, t.text)
    if lit != null
      for i = 0 to vec_len(lit) - 1
        vec_push(cands, vec_get(lit, i))
      end
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(p.lang.expr_slot) - 1
    vec_push(cands, vec_get(p.lang.expr_slot, i))
  end
  let far = ps_save_far(p)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(cands) - 1
    let r = lg_rule(cands, i)
    let s = ps_save(p)
    let n = ps_match(p, r, false)
    if n != null
      ps_restore_far(p, far)
      return n
    end
    ps_restore(p, s)
  end
  let rule_far = ps_save_far(p)
  ps_restore_far(p, far)
  if t.kind == TK_INT || t.kind == TK_CHAR
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let n = ps_node(p, "int", t)
    n.ival = t.ival
    n.ty = "int"
    if t.kind == TK_CHAR
      n.ty = "u8"
    end
    n.start = start
    n.stop = p.i
    return n
  elif t.kind == TK_STR
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let n = ps_node(p, "str", t)
    n.sval = t.text
    n.ty = "str"
    n.start = start
    n.stop = p.i
    return n
  elif t.kind == TK_IDENT
    if ps_keyword(p, t.text)
      let lit = lg_rules(p.lang.expr_lit, t.text)
      if rule_far.has && lit != null && vec_len(lit) > 0
        ps_restore_far(p, rule_far)
        pk_err = rule_far.err
        return null
      end
      return ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("expected an expression, found keyword ", lx_describe(t)))
    end
    let v = ps_lookup(p, t.text)
    if v == null
      let c = map_get(p.consts, t.text) as ptr PNode
      if c != null
        p.i = p.i + 1
        return ps_clone(c)
      end
      if vec_len(cands) > 0 && ps_is_lit(lx_tok(p.toks, p.i + 1), "(") && rule_far.has
        ps_restore_far(p, rule_far)
        pk_err = rule_far.err
        return null
      end
      if p.lenient
        v = new PVar
        v.name = t.text
        v.ty = "?"
        v.global = true
      else
        return ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("unknown variable ", lx_describe(t)))
      end
    end
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let n = ps_node(p, "var", t)
    n.vr = v
    n.ty = v.ty
    n.start = start
    n.stop = p.i
    return n
  elif t.kind == TK_PUNCT && t.text == "("
    p.i = p.i + 1
    let e = ps_expr(p, 0)
    if e == null
      return null
    end
    if !ps_is_lit(ps_tok(p), ")")
      return ps_fail(p, ps_tok(p), u_cat("expected ')', found ", lx_describe(ps_tok(p))))
    end
    p.i = p.i + 1
    return e
  end
  return ps_fail(p, t, u_cat("expected an expression, found ", lx_describe(t)))
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- expansion

fn ps_has_slot(es: ptr Vec, name: str) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, i)
    if e.slot != null && e.slot.name == name
      return true
    end
    if e.optional != null && ps_has_slot(e.optional, name)
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

fn ps_tok_copy(kind: int, text: str, at: ptr Tok) -> ptr Tok
  return lx_new(kind, text, at.file, at.line, at.col)
end

// ps_expand rewrites a matched node with its package's expand template and
// parses the result again.
fn ps_expand(p: ptr Parser, r: ptr LgRule, n: ptr PNode, s: ptr PSnap) -> ptr PNode
  if p.depth > 64
    pk_err = u_cat4(ps_pos(n), ": expansion of ", r.pkg.name, " nests too deeply (does it expand into itself?)")
    return null
  end
  let stop = p.i
  let outer = p.toks
  ps_unwind(p, s)
  let toks = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(r.tmpl) - 1
    let t = lx_tok(r.tmpl, i)
    if t.kind != TK_HOLE
      vec_push(toks, t as int)
      continue
    end
    if str_starts(t.text, "$")
      let name = str_slice(t.text, 1, len(t.text))
      let text = u_cat4("__", name, "_", u_cat4(str_from_int(n.line), "_", str_from_int(n.col), u_cat("_", str_from_int(p.depth))))
      vec_push(toks, ps_tok_copy(TK_IDENT, text, t) as int)
      continue
    end
    let c = ps_slot(n, t.text)
    if c == null
      if ps_has_slot(r.pat.elems, t.text)
        continue
      end
      pk_err = u_cat4(lx_pos(t), ": expand template uses unknown slot {", t.text, "}")
      p.toks = outer
      p.i = stop
      return null
    end
    let count = c.stop - c.start
    let wrap = c.kind != "block" && count > 1
    if wrap
      vec_push(toks, ps_tok_copy(TK_PUNCT, "(", lx_tok(c.toks, c.start)) as int)
    end
    for k = c.start to c.stop - 1
      vec_push(toks, vec_get(c.toks, k))
    end
    if wrap
      vec_push(toks, ps_tok_copy(TK_PUNCT, ")", lx_tok(c.toks, c.stop - 1)) as int)
    end
  end
  let at = lx_new(TK_NL, "", n.file, n.line, n.col)
  vec_push(toks, at as int)
  vec_push(toks, lx_new(TK_EOF, "", n.file, n.line, n.col) as int)

  p.toks = toks
  p.i = 0
  p.depth = p.depth + 1
  let out: ptr PNode = null
  if r.syn.kind == "statement"
    out = ps_node_at(p, "block", n)
    while true
      ps_skip_nl(p)
      if ps_tok(p).kind == TK_EOF
        break
      end
      let st = ps_statement(p, false)
      if st == null
        pk_err = u_cat4("in expansion of ", r.pkg.name, " at ", u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": ", ps_best(p, pk_err)))
        p.toks = outer
        p.i = stop
        p.depth = p.depth - 1
        return null
      end
      ps_add_item(out, st)
    end
  else
    let e = ps_expr(p, 0)
    if e == null
      pk_err = u_cat4("in expansion of ", r.pkg.name, " at ", u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": ", pk_err))
      p.toks = outer
      p.i = stop
      p.depth = p.depth - 1
      return null
    end
    ps_skip_nl(p)
    if ps_tok(p).kind != TK_EOF
      pk_err = u_cat4("in expansion of ", r.pkg.name, " at ", u_cat(ps_pos(n), ": template is not a single expression"))
      p.toks = outer
      p.i = stop
      p.depth = p.depth - 1
      return null
    end
    out = e
  end
  let ex = vec_new()
  u_push(ex, r.pkg.name)
  if out.expanded != null
    for i = 0 to vec_len(out.expanded) - 1
      u_push(ex, u_get(out.expanded, i))
    end
  end
  out.expanded = ex
  out.toks = outer
  out.start = n.start
  out.stop = stop
  p.toks = outer
  p.i = stop
  p.depth = p.depth - 1
  return out
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- checks

fn ps_declare_struct(p: ptr Parser, n: ptr PNode, t: ptr Tok) -> bool
  let name = ""
  let fields: ptr PNode = null
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    let c = ps_nd(n.svals, i)
    if c.kind == "newtype"
      name = c.ident
    elif c.kind == "fields"
      fields = c
    end
  end
  if name == "" || fields == null
    pk_err = u_cat(n.rule.pkg.origin, ": a struct pattern needs a newtype slot and a fields slot")
    return false
  end
  let st = ty_struct(p.types, name)
  if vec_len(st.fields) > 0
    return true
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(fields) - 1
    let fd = ps_nd(fields.items, i)
    let f = new TyField
    f.name = fd.ident
    f.ty = fd.ty
    vec_push(st.fields, f as int)
  end
  if !ty_layout(p.types, st)
    if p.lenient && u_has(pk_err, "unknown type")
      // a field's type is declared later: lay it out in the second pass
      st.fields = vec_new()
      return true
    end
    ps_fail(p, t, pk_err)
    return false
  end
  return true
end

fn ps_check_node(p: ptr Parser, n: ptr PNode) -> bool
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    let c = ps_nd(n.svals, i)
    if c.kind != "func"
      continue
    end
    let sig = map_get(p.sigs, c.ident) as ptr PSig
    for k = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
      let a = ps_nd(n.svals, k)
      if a.kind != "args"
        continue
      end
      if ps_nitems(a) != vec_len(sig.params)
        pk_err = u_cat4(ps_pos(c), ": ", c.ident, u_cat4(" takes ", str_from_int(vec_len(sig.params)), " argument(s), got ", str_from_int(ps_nitems(a))))
        return false
      end
      for m = 0 to ps_nitems(a) - 1
        let arg = ps_nd(a.items, m)
        if !ty_compatible(u_get(sig.params, m), arg.ty)
          pk_err = u_cat4(ps_pos(arg), ": argument ", str_from_int(m + 1), u_cat4(" of ", c.ident, " must be ", u_cat3(u_get(sig.params, m), ", but it is ", ps_describe_type(arg.ty))))
          return false
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    if !ps_check_node(p, ps_nd(n.svals, i))
      return false
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    if !ps_check_node(p, ps_nd(n.items, i))
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

fn ps_check_calls(p: ptr Parser, prog: ptr PProg) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.top) - 1
    if !ps_check_node(p, ps_nd(prog.top, i))
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dump ast

fn ps_node_line(n: ptr PNode) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, n.kind)
  sb_add(b, " #")
  sb_int(b, n.id)
  sb_add(b, " @")
  sb_add(b, ps_pos(n))
  if n.ty != ""
    sb_add(b, " : ")
    sb_add(b, n.ty)
  end
  let k = n.kind
  if k == "int"
    sb_add(b, " = ")
    sb_int(b, n.ival)
  elif k == "str"
    sb_add(b, " = ")
    sb_add(b, pf_dquote(n.sval))
  elif k == "var"
    let where = "local"
    if n.vr.param
      where = "param"
    elif n.vr.global
      where = "global"
    end
    sb_add(b, u_cat4(" ", n.vr.name, " ", where))
    sb_byte(b, ' ')
    sb_int(b, n.vr.index)
  elif k == "ident" || k == "func" || k == "newfunc" || k == "newtype" || k == "fielddecl" || k == "newconst"
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" ", n.ident))
  elif k == "field"
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" ", n.ident))
    if n.field != null
      sb_add(b, " offset ")
      sb_int(b, n.field.offset)
    end
  end
  if n.expanded != null && vec_len(n.expanded) > 0
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" expanded=", u_join(n.expanded, ",")))
  end
  if n.frame != null
    let f = n.frame
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" frame name=", f.name))
    sb_add(b, " params=")
    sb_int(b, f.params)
    sb_add(b, " locals=")
    sb_int(b, f.slots)
    sb_add(b, " size=")
    sb_int(b, ps_frame_size(f))
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" ret=", pf_dquote(f.ret)))
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn ps_dump_walk(b: ptr StrBuf, n: ptr PNode, depth: int, label: str)
  for i = 1 to depth
    sb_add(b, "  ")
  end
  sb_add(b, label)
  sb_add(b, ps_node_line(n))
  sb_byte(b, '\n')
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    ps_dump_walk(b, ps_nd(n.svals, i), depth + 1, u_cat(u_get(n.snames, i), ": "))
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    ps_dump_walk(b, ps_nd(n.items, i), depth + 1, "- ")
  end
end

fn ps_dump(prog: ptr PProg) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, "program frame locals=")
  sb_int(b, prog.frame.slots)
  sb_add(b, " size=")
  sb_int(b, ps_frame_size(prog.frame))
  sb_byte(b, '\n')
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.top) - 1
    ps_dump_walk(b, ps_nd(prog.top, i), 1, "- ")
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end
